title: Day Trip is Enough
text:
The check-in process was unorganised and waiting around, not knowing what was going on. 
But the experience itself was great. Coach was clean and comfortable. 
A day trip to Gibraltar is enough to see the Rock, cave and history. 
Would recommend it, if you have time.
